text:
maya: Heads-up — planning a staggered changelog freeze for the DevEx release next week. Goal: avoid blocking platform teams while we cut quickstarts + sampleapps. See proposed windows below. Please state ownership and blockers by EOD today. :wave:

kevin: Proposed windows look good. I can own sample-apps (node + py) during Wed 09:00-13:00 PT. Need CI green for 4 PRs (https://github.com/redwood/sample-apps/pulls) or I'll push to Thu.

sam: Docs team will freeze the docs site during Thu 12:00-16:00 PT. Will need final copy for the new SDK flags by Wed EOD. @maya who's owner for SDK changelog entries?

maya: @sam I'll own SDK changelog entries. @jordana can you confirm quickstart gists are updated with new auth snippet?

jordana: Yep — quickstart gists are on branch quickstart-auth-update. CI currently failing on lint, fixing now. ETA 2 hours. Also need sampleapp env var names changed (API_KEY -> REDWOOD_API_KEY).

eli: FYI, Dedicated infra has a rolling deploy that may affect dev endpoints during Fri morning; recommend sample apps avoid deploy window 06:00-10:00 PT on Fri.

devex-bot: Reminder — changelog cutoff label applied to 3 PRs: #412, #419, #423. Ping reviewers.

anna: I'll own doc redirects + release notes formatting. Can someone drop final PR numbers in this thread once they merge?

kevin: PRs for sampleapps merged: #88, #89, #93. Node sampleapp needs one more approval @sam

sam: Approved #93. Docs snippet for SDK flag pushed in #207. @jordana once lint fixed I'll merge quickstart branch.

jordana: Lint fixed, branch merged. Quickstarts now reference REDWOOD_API_KEY and new init flow. :tada:

maya: OK — timeline recap:
- Wed 09:00-13:00 PT: sampleapps freeze (kevin)
- Wed EOD: SDK changelog entries (maya)
- Thu 12:00-16:00 PT: docs freeze (sam)
- Fri 06:00-10:00 PT: avoid deploy (eli)
If no blockers, we'll apply changelog cutoff Thu 16:05 PT and fold release notes. Please add PR numbers here when merged.

kevin: Noted. I'll post a final merge list after 11:30 PT Wed.

eli: I'll post infra window notice to eng-infra channel and pin it.

sam: All set from docs side once #207 linked in release notes.

maya: Thanks all. If anything blocks, tag me and put changelog-cutoff:hold label. :pray:

kevin: Quick question — do we need to update sampleapp images in CDN? That was on the checklist earlier.

jordana: Good catch. I updated images in #95; CDN purge triggered by CI. Confirmed propagated to staging.

anna: Final note — I'll assemble release notes draft and ping legal for trademark check by Thu morning.

maya: Perfect. Closing the loop — will send summary to #release-ops after cutoff. :locked_with_key:

kevin: :thumbsup:

sam: :eyes:

devex-bot: Scheduled reminder set for Thu 16:00 PT to apply changelog cutoff.
